title: Payslip for October 2026
key_sentences: Your pay for October includes the 2026 pay award, which has been backdated to 1 April.
Net pay of 2,077.49 was sent to your bank on 30 October.
If anything on this payslip looks wrong, contact Payroll Services within 14 days.
Please keep this payslip with your tax records.

rows: Overtime at time and a half (hours)

list_items.text: Check that the tax code 1257L matches the letter you received from the tax office.
Report a change of address or bank details to Payroll Services in writing.
Pension contributions are taken before income tax is worked out.
